protocol.title: Khulna Coastal Early Warning & Siren Protocol
protocol.details: Red Crescent Cyclone Preparedness Programme (CPP) volunteers deploy megaphone alerts and hoist signal flags 4 to 10 upon BMD bulletins. Move elderly and children to shelters early.

protocol.title: River Bhairab & Rupsha Tidal Surge Flood Safety Protocol
protocol.capacity: Canal Sluice Gate Control: 12 Active Stations
protocol.details: During full-moon spring tides or upstream tidal surges, stay clear of low-lying embankments. Boil drinking water or use water purification tablets provided by WASA.

protocol.title: Urban Fire Outbreak & Chemical Storage Protocol
protocol.details: Immediately evacuate narrow alleys; do not use elevators. Fire Service Control room coordinates foam units for warehouse zones. Keep municipal hydrants unobstructed.

protocol.title: Bengal Basin Tectonic Shock & Structural Safety Protocol
protocol.capacity: Emergency Assembly Zones: Hadis Park & Circuit House Maidan
protocol.details: Drop, Cover, and Hold On under heavy furniture. Stay clear of glass windows and overhead power lines. Assemble at designated open grounds after ground shaking ceases.
